mainEntity.name: My Hickory house is on city water. Could it still have a septic tank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. City water and city sewer are separate questions, and plenty of homes around Hickory are on public water with a private septic system. Check the tax record, the disclosure statement, or look for a cleanout and a tank lid in the yard, and when in doubt, ask.

mainEntity.name: Which county holds the septic permit for a Hickory property?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the parcel. Most of Hickory is in Catawba County; parts of the city reach into Burke and Caldwell counties. The county listed on the tax record is the one whose environmental health office has the permit.

mainEntity.name: Do you inspect lake houses on Lake Hickory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lake lots often have tight setbacks and steep grades, so mention it when you book. If the property flooded during Helene, say that too, and I'll give the drain field area extra attention.
